headline: Ordinance changes to add a Solid Waste Enterprise Fund and a Reserve and Stabilization Fund Framework to city finance code.
summary: The committees will discuss amending Malden's city code to add a Solid Waste Enterprise Fund and a Reserve and Stabilization Fund Framework under Title 3 Revenue and Finance.
items: Ordinance 385-26: Add 3.05 Solid Waste Enterprise Fund to Title 3 Revenue and Finance, sponsored by Stephen Winslow, Karen Colon Hayes, Carey McDonald and Ryan O'Malley
Ordinance 388-26: Add 3.10 Reserve and Stabilization Fund Framework to Title 3 Revenue and Finance, sponsored by Amanda Linehan, Ryan O'Malley and Stephen Winslow
location: City Hall, Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
